headline: Foggy mornings, sunny afternoons through Thursday; a weak front brings cooler weather Friday.
summary: High pressure keeps western Washington mostly dry through Thursday. Fog and low clouds return overnight, most likely north of Seattle, with sunny and seasonably warm afternoons. A weak front arrives late Friday into Saturday, bringing only very light rain over the Cascades and northern Puget Sound. It is short-lived but brings a cooler change, with Friday highs in the low 60s and breezy winds along the coast and Sound waterfronts. Snow levels drop to around 5,000 feet, so the North Cascades may get a dusting. The weekend turns colder under low pressure, and frost or freeze concerns for sensitive plants are still being watched. Cool weather should last into early next week, with rain possible Tuesday into Wednesday, though models disagree on the details.
